name: school
description: A cozy woodland schoolhouse where young animal friends learn together.

color_palette: Warm beige (#F5F5DC) for stone pillars and walls
Soft terracotta (#CC7357) for roof tiles and accents
Muted olive green (#808000) for surrounding vegetation
visual_style.architectural_style: A small ancient Greek-inspired school with stone pillars and a low, sloped roof. The building features a covered porch supported by classical columns, creating a welcoming entrance. The structure sits on a raised foundation with wide, shallow steps leading to the entrance.
visual_style.flora_fauna: Surrounded by olive trees and Mediterranean shrubs. Small lizards bask on warm stones and butterflies flutter among wildflowers. The area features small patches of thyme and rosemary.
visual_style.furniture: Tiny stone desks and low wooden stools arranged in a semicircle. A small teacher's podium made of stone at the front with a papyrus scroll display. Shelves carved into the stone walls hold clay tablets and scrolls. A woven rug with geometric patterns covers the floor center.
materials: Stone pillars with simple Doric capitals
